reaction.clarification: Cannot cancel Soviet card #4 'KGB Assassinations'.

ops.title: Replacement Air Wings
ops.text: Fully restore any two carrier air wings to full strength. -REMOVE FROM PLAY-
ops.clarification: Fully restore (even destroyed and removed from play) two different entire Air Wings/Groups (could be up to four air units total). Return to carrier if possible, otherwise to a local airfield.

reaction.title: Phalanx & Sea Sparrow
reaction.text: Play when a US aircraft carrier is hit by a missile. Ignore the hit on a die roll of 4 or higher. *US point defense guns and missiles defend the carrier.*

ops.title: UNREP
ops.text: Play to remove spent markers on up to four carrier air units. (strike or fighters).

reaction.title: Roaming Fighters
reaction.text: Play when a Soviet air strike is in any zone west of Iceland or the United Kingdom. Use this unit for interception and ignore negative modifiers.

ops.title: False Contact
ops.text: Select one Soviet submarine and mark it spent.

reaction.title: SAM Trap
reaction.text: Select one ship in a TF under Soviet air attack. Roll one attack die with it against enemy strike units for every 2 SAM points it has as though it was a fighter on CAP. This ship does not contribute further to the combat resolution. *Remember saves vs. CAP kills.*

ops.title: SURTASS
ops.text: In a sea zone south of the GIUK Gap, roll four anti-submarine warfare dice. Then, if you wish, select a unit in the zone to perform these attacks and apply its tactical value to the rolls. Mark the unit spent. *SURveillance Towed Array Sensor System – a towed SONAR system deployed on surface ships.*
ops.clarification: Can be air unit or submarine, patrolling or unspent — but not any spent unit.

reaction.title: Nixie
reaction.text: Play when a NATO capital ship is hit by a torpedo. Ignore the hit unless the shooting submarine has heavyweight torpedoes.
reaction.clarification: Protects against nuclear torpedos but, as written, not against heavyweight torpedoes.
reaction.notes: Card shows a small 'T' icon after 'torpedoes' indicating heavyweight torpedo type

ops.title: Carriers Support Germany
ops.text: Until 'next day', US carriers may launch attacks into Germany targeting Soviet armies (Fly strikes to the North Sea zone). If escorted, ignore the first two hits scored by NATO when determining the SAM attacks to resolve. Every 5 hits scored places a partial convoy marker.
ops.clarification: Lasts until next day, not a one-time attack. Use the procedure in 17.24 Striking Soviet Troop Markers.

reaction.title: Planning & Preparation
reaction.text: Play to form any two NATO TFs at no cost.

ops.title: Nuclear Fear
ops.text: If NATO is at 12-17 or higher on the 'Soviet Nuclear Strike Capability Track', and the Soviets have used nuclear weapons, apply -1 to Soviet stability. Only one of these cards may be used per turn. -REMOVE FROM PLAY-
ops.clarification: Move Soviet Stability one box towards coup.

reaction.title: Boomer Hunting
reaction.text: Play when a Soviet SSBN is killed. The Soviet Player is forced to discard 1 FSP. *The Politburo disapproves.*

ops.title: Space Shuttle
ops.text: Roll a die. On a roll of 5+, remove a RORSAT step of your choice.

reaction.title: Acoustic Simulators
reaction.text: Play when the Soviet player uses a 10 rolled by a submarine to detect a task force. Ignore the roll. *NATO decoys that sounds like a carrier or convoy force to an attacking submarine.*

ops.title: Fast Convoy
ops.text: Place a Fast convoy in the US if available. -REMOVE FROM PLAY-

reaction.title: Orders from Moscow
reaction.text: Play if a NATO convoy is detected. The Soviet Player must attack it as his next action with naval aviation strike aircraft if any are available and in range (including by tanking). At least four steps must attack if they are available. If unwilling to do so, the Soviet may instead lose 2 ops and 1 'First Strike' marker.

ops.title: Tomahawk Anti-ship Missile
ops.text: Up to 3 US submarines in the same zone may attack a detected enemy task force in their zone with 1 point of NATO missiles per submarine. They may coordinate without die roll. LA VLS or I fire with 2 points each but mark empty. Do NOT mark them spent. Any one of the submarines may move one zone before performing this attack.
ops.clarification: Treat as standard regular long-range attack without modification. However, modify for NATO weapons.

reaction.title: Air Patrols
reaction.text: Use this card when a Soviet air strike is being intercepted. Roll one additional die.
reaction.clarification: Only applies to interceptors, not CAP.

ops.title: Tomahawk Anti-ship Missile
ops.text: Up to 3 US submarines in the same zone may attack a detected enemy task force in their zone with 1 point of NATO missiles per submarine. They may coordinate without die roll. LA VLS or I fire with 2 points each but mark empty. Do NOT mark them spent. Any one of the submarines may move one zone before performing this attack.
ops.clarification: Treat as standard regular long-range attack without modification. However, modify for NATO weapons.

reaction.title: Diesels Snorkeling
reaction.text: Play when conducting anti-submarine warfare in a sea zone with an enemy diesel submarine. Cause one step loss to any diesel submarine of your choice.

ops.title: Special Forces
ops.text: Choose any target facility and roll one die on the 'Air-to-Ground Bombing Table'. -REMOVE FROM PLAY-
ops.clarification: This attack is not modified for bad weather — straight roll.

reaction.title: Emissions Control
reaction.text: Ignore any detection successes rolled by one Soviet maritime patrol aircraft against TFs. *Measures to reduce the signature of a task force and confuse the enemy.*

ops.title: Submarine UNREP
ops.text: Remove 'spent' and 'no ammo' markers from any three submarines South of the GIUK Gap. Not Baltic, Black Sea or Med 7-8. A submarine in bad weather cannot be chosen. (*Cost 1 if no ammo markers removed).

reaction.title: GIUK Gap Patrol
reaction.text: Play when a Soviet unit enters an active hydrophone zone in the GIUK Gap. Move any NATO submarine up to one zone and remove a spent marker from it. If now in a hydrophone zone, it may interrupt per 6.8.
reaction.notes: Reaction cost shown as 3* (asterisk denotes conditional cost mentioned in Ops text)

ops.title: Submarine UNREP
ops.text: Remove 'spent' and 'no ammo' markers from any three submarines South of the GIUK Gap. Not Baltic, Black Sea or Med 7-8. A submarine in bad weather cannot be chosen. (*Cost 1 if no ammo markers removed).

reaction.title: Distant Support
reaction.text: A US Carrier may commit its F-14 air unit to an air attack within one zone if any of the attacking strike is detected by an interceptor. Mark it spent afterwards.
reaction.clarification: CL#12. Treat the F-14 as CAP. The US Carrier must be adjacent to the air strike.
reaction.notes: Reaction cost shown as 3* (asterisk denotes conditional cost mentioned in Ops text)

ops.title: Eagles
ops.text: Add one available F-15 to any NATO airbase. -REMOVE FROM PLAY-

reaction.title: ASM-135 ASAT
reaction.text: Play immediately before the Soviet Player rolls for a RORSAT to detect a surface TF. Place the RORSAT in the 'Destroyed Box' on a roll of 3+ on one die.

ops.title: Fighters to Norway/Denmark
ops.text: Place two steps of fighters (any from UK, grounded F-14s, or 'Eagles') in any Norwegian or Danish airbase.
ops.clarification: 'Grounded' here means F-14s on the turn track as a consequence of their carrier being repaired.

reaction.title: Roaming Fighters
reaction.text: Play when a Soviet air strike is in any zone west of Iceland or the United Kingdom. Use this unit for interception and ignore negative modifiers.

ops.title: CAPTOR Mines
ops.text: Place one CAPTOR minefield in any sea zone. Requires a 6+ to place in the Barents or Baltic Sea. *Mines with built-in SONAR which launch a torpedo at detected targets.*

reaction.title: GIUK Gap Patrol
reaction.text: Play when a Soviet unit enters an active hydrophone zone in the GIUK Gap. Move any NATO submarine up to one zone and remove a spent marker from it. If now in a hydrophone zone, it may interrupt per 6.8.

ops.title: B-52 Strikes
ops.text: Cost in 1983 is 4. Attack any facility on the map with a B-52 strike using bombs (or 2 dice of cruise missiles in 1989). From 1985, you may use the B-52 to attack a TF at sea with 12 NATO missiles.

ops.title: Patriot
ops.text: Deploy a Patriot counter to any NATO facility.

reaction.title: Fighter Recovery
reaction.text: If a US carrier is damaged or sunk, use this card to place its air units at any airbase within two sea zones (including another carrier that lost its planes). If the carrier is repaired, you may place the units back with their carrier.

ops.title: Repairs
ops.text: Remove one hit from any facility.

reaction.title: Friendly Fire
reaction.text: Play when an enemy submarine or maritime patrol aircraft performs anti-submarine warfare and scores no hits. Cause a hit to an enemy submarine in the same zone.
reaction.clarification: Saved hits do not count as 'no hit'.

ops.title: Eagles
ops.text: Add one available F-15 to any NATO airbase. –REMOVE FROM PLAY–

reaction.title: ASM Coordinated Attack
reaction.text: Play to attack a good detected enemy task force in the same zone as a friendly TF. Select two friendly ships and attack the enemy TF with anti-ship missiles from both, then mark them with 'Anti-Ship Missiles Fired'.

ops.title: RAF Replacements
ops.text: Replace up to two steps of RAF fighters.

reaction.title: ASM Attack
reaction.text: Play to attack a good detected TF in the same zone as a friendly TF. Select one friendly ship to attack any enemy TF with anti-ship missiles, then mark 'Anti-Ship Missiles Fired'.

ops.title: Minesweepers
ops.text: Degrade any mine counter.
ops.clarification: Degrade Soviet port mines.

reaction.title: ASM Attack
reaction.text: Play to attack a good detected TF in the same zone as a friendly TF. Select one friendly ship to attack any enemy TF with anti-ship missiles, then mark 'Anti-Ship Missiles Fired'.

ops.title: UNREP
ops.text: Play to remove spent markers on up to four carrier air units. (strike or fighters)

reaction.title: Fighter Recovery
reaction.text: If a US carrier is damaged or sunk, use this card to place its air units at any airbase within two sea zones (including another carrier that lost its planes). If the carrier is repaired, you may place the units back with their carrier.

ops.title: Attack Tyuratam
ops.text: US attack on Soviet space launching facilities. Play of this event prevents further Soviet RORSAT launches this turn and allows a single launch next turn. Also roll 5 dice and destroy one RORSAT in the 'Tyuratam Box' for each 6+ rolled. The Soviet Player gains a FSP. –REMOVE FROM PLAY– *Tyuratam (now Baikonur Cosmodrome) was the Soviet ballistic missile test range and home to the Soviet space programme.*

ops.title: RAF Strike
ops.text: This card allows the British Buccaneer and unit below to fly an air strike. The event cost pays for the strike to fly.
ops.clarification: Bombing only, no missiles. Tornado has two steps. A Buccaneer 'actual' unit has to join in the strike.

reaction.title: NATO Counter Attack
reaction.text: If a convoy arrives with 0 or 1 hit and it is Turn 3 or later, immediately move the 'War Track' one box right. –REMOVE FROM PLAY–
reaction.clarification: Convoy is removed because it arrived at a convoy port — supplies are received as normal. Then the card effect is implemented. Per normal rules, convoy is then placed in the Convoy Holding Box.

ops.title: NATO Flexibility
ops.text: This card gives 5 ops in addition to cards value which can only be spent on non-US units. Track the ops spent with markers on this card.
ops.clarification: Cannot be used to repair a damaged allied facility — only for units.

reaction.title: Counter Intelligence
reaction.text: If the Soviet Player uses his spies, instead of rolling for reduction, automatically reduce the 'Soviet Spy Track' by one.

ops.title: Space Tracking
ops.text: Select any two RORSATS and remove both from the map. Return one to the game each time ships move, after completing the move process. When they return to the game, the Soviet player may place them in any zone.

reaction.title: Raid Aborts
reaction.text: Play when any unit in an air raid is detected by interception. Roll 1 die per unit, aborting each on a roll of 5+. Then the Soviet Player may choose to abort the remainder.

ops.title: Perfectly Timed Strike
ops.text: Use when attacking a Soviet airbase before resolving. Automatically cause one additional step loss selected by you, if you cause one hit.
ops.clarification: SEAD hits do not count.

reaction.title: Nixie
reaction.text: Play when a NATO capital ship is hit by a torpedo. Ignore the hit unless the shooting submarine has heavyweight torpedoes. *A towed torpedo decoy*
reaction.clarification: Protects against nuclear torpedos but, as written, not against heavyweight torpedoes.

ops.title: Norwegian Sabotage
ops.text: If a Soviet airbase exists in Norway, roll one die on the 'Air-to-Ground Bombing Table'.

reaction.title: Raid Aborts
reaction.text: Play when any unit in an air raid is detected by interception. Roll 1 die per unit, aborting each on a roll of 5+. Then the Soviet Player may choose to abort the remainder.

ops.clarification: Cannot be used to repair a damaged allied facility — only for units.

reaction.title: Phalanx and Sea Sparrow
reaction.text: Play when a US aircraft carrier is hit by a missile. Ignore the hit on a die roll of 4 or higher. *US point defense guns and missiles defend the carrier.*

ops.title: First Strike
ops.text: If there are less than 4 payload of Soviet SSBN in the First Strike zones, the Soviet Player must discard 1 FSP. **Only one per turn is playable.**

reaction.title: SAM Trap
reaction.text: Select one ship in a TF under Soviet air attack. Roll one attack die with it against enemy strike units for every 2 SAM points it has as though it was a fighter on CAP. This ship does not contribute further to the combat resolution. Remember saves vs. CAP kills.

ops.title: Deep Water SOSUS
ops.text: Until 'next day' all NATO anti-submarine warfare in a single nominated sea zone within the East, Med or West weather zones receive +1 dice. Mark the zone. *Submarine noise, detected over long distances by special arrays deployed on the ocean floor.*

reaction.title: Orion Harpoons
reaction.text: Play when an Echo II or Juliett submarine launches missiles in the same zone as an on-patrol US maritime patrol aircraft. Immediately perform an Anti-submarine warfare attack with two extra dice. Any sunk Soviet submarine steps do not fire.
reaction.clarification: Required presence of MP triggers CAP interception per 17.2: 'An Air Unit is present within a Sea Zone with carrier-based FTR prior to completing whatever mission it was sent to perform'.

ops.title: Fighting in Iran
ops.text: Place spent markers on any two Soviet strike units in Syria. *Soviets ordered to support fighting in Iran and the Middle East.*

reaction.title: Quickstrike Mines
reaction.text: Place when US Carrier Air Group(s) attack a Soviet port. Instead of attacking with bombs, place a light mine or a heavy mine if there are three or more steps that could bomb.

ops.title: German Tornado
ops.text: Remove the German strike aircraft from the game. Place a partial convoy in Europe if three or more steps are removed.
ops.clarification: Partial convoy goes on the Northern war track.

reaction.title: Snoopers Detect Raid
reaction.text: Play to apply the 'detected by interceptors' (+1 die modifier) against an air strike. Playable if there are at least two steps of NATO submarines in a sea zone adjacent to the base of origin and the Soviet ASAT system is inactive.

ops.title: Politburo Interference
ops.text: This card must be the first NATO ops card used this turn. If the Soviet player does not attack a NATO SSBN this turn, discard 1 FSP and draw one less card next turn. If there are no FSPs to discard, draw two less cards next turn.

reaction.title: NATO Counter Attack
reaction.text: If a convoy arrives with 0 or 1 hit and it is Turn 3 or later, immediately move the 'War Track' one box right. –REMOVE FROM PLAY–
reaction.clarification: Convoy is removed because it arrived at a convoy port — supplies are received as normal. Then the card effect is implemented. Per normal rules, convoy is then placed in the Convoy Holding Box.

ops.title: Naval Yard Expertise
ops.text: Move any capital ship that is being repaired two turns closer to the current turn. If it moves to the current turn, receive it immediately.

reaction.title: Diesels Snorkeling
reaction.text: Play when resolving anti-submarine warfare in a sea zone with an enemy diesel submarine. Cause one step loss to any diesel submarine of your choice.

ops.text: Place two steps of fighters (any from UK, grounded F-14s, or 'Eagles') in any Norwegian or Danish airbase.
ops.clarification: 'Grounded' here means F-14s on the turn track as a consequence of their carrier being repaired.

reaction.title: Diesels Snorkeling
reaction.text: Play when resolving anti-submarine warfare in a sea zone with an enemy diesel submarine. Cause one step loss to any diesel submarine of your choice.

ops.title: Turkish Air Strike
ops.text: Launch an attack with the units on this card from a Turkish port facility. –REMOVE FROM PLAY–
ops.clarification: CL#6. Turkish airstrike card does not have the range to reach Sevastopol. Design decision rather than capability.

reaction.title: Air Patrols
reaction.text: Use this card when a Soviet air strike is intercepted. Roll one additional die.
reaction.clarification: Only applies to interceptors, not CAP.

ops.title: Submarine Breakdown!
ops.text: Select a Soviet submarine and roll a die, causing a step loss on a 9+. Add 2 to the roll if an Alfa submarine is selected.

reaction.title: Snoopers Detect Raid
reaction.text: Play to apply the 'detected by interceptors' (+1 die modifier) against an air strike. Playable if there are at least two steps of NATO submarines in a sea zone adjacent to the base of origin and the Soviet ASAT system is inactive.

ops.title: Italian Air Strike
ops.text: Play to launch an attack with the units printed on this card. NAS Sigonella must be undamaged. For +1 ops, increase the range to 2 (tanker support). If the Soviets are not yet in Venice (South War Track) you may take this card back in your hand at the end of the turn.
ops.clarification: Can be used to attack the Southern War Track.

ops.title: Elite Submariner
ops.text: Select a NATO submarine, optionally move it one zone, and cause a step loss on any selected Soviet submarine on a 6+ die roll.

reaction.title: Friendly Fire
reaction.text: Play when an enemy submarine or maritime patrol aircraft performs anti-submarine warfare and scores no hits. Cause a hit to an enemy submarine in the same zone.
reaction.clarification: Saved hits do not count as 'no hit'.

ops.title: Strike Strategic Targets (Kola)
ops.text:
Place two target markers in the Kola Peninsula. These can be attacked for the following effects:
Ammo Storage (1 hit): NATO Player marks two air units at the Kola bases spent. They may not refresh this turn.
C3 Nodes (2 hits): The Soviet Player must discard the two highest cards held. At 'next day', the Soviet Player must play the lowest valued card held. –REMOVE FROM PLAY–
ops.clarification: No FSP granted to Soviet per 17.23 as it normally would. Can be attacked by any method available — generally an air strike or cruise missiles.

ops.title: Strike Strategic Targets (Sevastopol)
ops.text:
Place 2 target markers near Sevastopol. These can be attacked for the following effects:
Nuclear Sites (2 hits): Roll one Soviet stability check.
C3 Nodes (1 hit): The Soviet player must discard the highest card held. If this drops below 3 cards held, the Soviet hand is reduced for the rest of the turn. –REMOVE FROM PLAY–
ops.clarification: Effect of hitting C# Nodes is an exception to the rule 'a player will always have three cards'. Can be attacked by any method available — generally an air strike or cruise missiles.
